content:
Overview

Hawassa is a city in Sidama with a population of 350,000. The capital of the Sidama Region, a fast-growing city on Lake Hawassa known for its university and fish market. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
